no_query_prior.instruction: No query-property prior is supplied in this ablation. Treat earlier references to a supplied prior as inapplicable and base the prediction on the visible query and evidence molecules, experimental records, and retrieval scores.

changes: Materialize every resolved Jinja and YAML prompt asset in this bundle.
Show query-property-prior instructions only when a query prior is present.
Show only Morgan similarity for Morgan-ranked panels and both scores for assay-transfer-ranked panels.
Use the score-neutral context-order instruction surface and deterministic reasoning-reference index.
Optionally show hash-pinned cached structure descriptions for the query and L1 molecules, omitting unavailable rows.
